display-mobile.purpose: The name at viewport widths of 640px or less.

title.purpose: Stack headings; other compact headings retain their source-specific leading.

body.purpose: General prose, with a readable paragraph measure.

article-body.purpose: Article paragraphs and lists with more open leading.

label.purpose: Navigation, action links and disclosure summaries.

metadata.purpose: Article dates, types and application context; dates use tabular numerals.

tag.purpose: Unboxed technology names and compact supporting text.

code.purpose: Technical code examples, never decorative labeling.

motion.name: state-indicator
motion.purpose: Menu rules and disclosure SVG respond to open state.

motion.name: anchor-scroll
motion.purpose: In-page navigation; becomes auto for reduced-motion preference.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto
motion.purpose: Production prefers-reduced-motion override; no decorative loop is present.

components.name: Outline action
components.description: The shared outline action, with ink hover and visible focus; preview has no attached action.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 18px; min-height: 46px; border: 1px solid var(--text, #17202a); background: none; color: var(--text, #17202a); text-decoration: none; font: 14px/1.65 var(--font, Archivo, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-button:hover { color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); background: var(--text, #17202a);  } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2549ce); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.55; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button { transition: none; } }

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Cobalt emphasis for a concrete action such as opening the game; preview has no attached action.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 18px; min-height: 46px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #2549ce); background: var(--accent, #2549ce); color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); text-decoration: none; font: 14px/1.65 var(--font, Archivo, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); background: var(--accent-strong, #18379e); border-color: var(--accent-strong, #18379e); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2549ce); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.55; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Header navigation
components.description: Shared desktop link treatment; production adds the responsive toggle and Escape/focus behavior.
components.html: WorkWritingReadingTR
components.css: .ds-navigation { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: clamp(16px, 2vw, 28px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--text, #17202a); font-family: var(--font, Archivo, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); } .ds-navigation a { color: var(--text, #17202a); text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65; padding-block: 12px; white-space: nowrap; text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-navigation a:hover, .ds-navigation [aria-current='page'] { color: var(--accent, #2549ce); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-navigation .ds-locale { margin-left: 8px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-navigation a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2549ce); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Project filters
components.description: Text controls with a bottom rule for the selected state; production JavaScript changes the pressed state, hidden projects and live count.
components.css: .ds-filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 24px; padding-bottom: 24px; } .ds-filters button { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 0; color: var(--muted, #505b68); background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; font: 14px/1.65 var(--font, Archivo, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-filters button:hover { color: var(--accent, #2549ce); } .ds-filters button[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--text, #17202a); border-bottom-color: var(--text, #17202a); } .ds-filters button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2549ce); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-filters { gap: 0 22px; padding-bottom: 18px; } .ds-filters button { font-size: 13px; } }

components.name: Technology tags
components.description: Non-interactive text metadata with no filled badge or pill.
components.css: .ds-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 16px; margin-top: 16px; } .ds-tags span { font: 12px/1.65 var(--font, Archivo, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); color: var(--muted, #505b68); }

components.name: Project index entry
components.description: An open ruled entry, with heading/context and a wider explanatory column.
components.html:
IBBCAM

Map + Health Runtime

Camera monitoring and data proxy architecture

Created a FastAPI-backed monitoring application that parses camera source data, protects sensitive fields, exposes clean API endpoints and serves a browser-based operational map interface.

Source on GitHub
components.css: .ds-project { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .88fr) minmax(0, 1.12fr); gap: 48px; padding: 40px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #cdd3dc); color: var(--text, #17202a); font: 16px/1.65 var(--font, Archivo, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); } .ds-project h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.2vw, 2.8rem); line-height: 1.12; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.03em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-project-kind { margin: 0 0 22px; color: var(--muted, #505b68); font-size: 14px; } .ds-project-subtitle { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 30ch; } .ds-project-body { min-width: 0; } .ds-project-body > p { color: var(--muted, #505b68); margin: 0 0 18px; max-width: 72ch; } .ds-project a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; font-size: 14px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-project a:hover { color: var(--accent, #2549ce); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-project svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; } .ds-project a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2549ce); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (max-width: 1000px) { .ds-project { gap: 32px; } } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-project { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 16px; padding-block: 28px; } .ds-project h3 { font-size: 30px; } .ds-project-kind { margin-bottom: 14px; } .ds-project-subtitle { max-width: none; margin-bottom: 4px; } }

components.name: Engineering disclosure
components.description: Native details/summary provides the expandable content behavior without a framework.
components.html:
Engineering details
  • Parsed XML camera records and exposed only whitelisted public fields.
  • Built background health tracking and lightweight liveness endpoints.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { margin-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #cdd3dc); color: var(--text, #17202a); font: 14px/1.65 var(--font, Archivo, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); } .ds-disclosure summary { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 52px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-disclosure summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-disclosure summary:hover { color: var(--accent, #2549ce); } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2549ce); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-disclosure svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; flex: 0 0 auto; transition: transform 180ms ease; } .ds-disclosure[open] svg { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-disclosure ul { margin: 8px 0 16px; padding-left: 20px; color: var(--muted, #505b68); } .ds-disclosure li { padding-left: 4px; margin-bottom: 12px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-disclosure { margin-top: 16px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-disclosure svg { transition: none; } }

components.name: Writing row
components.description: A ruled writing entry with compact metadata and an open headline, not an elevated card.
components.html:
Technical note

Industrial telemetry pipeline

Technical writing about telemetry, architecture and software delivery.
components.css: .ds-writing { padding: 32px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #cdd3dc); color: var(--text, #17202a); font: 16px/1.65 var(--font, Archivo, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); } .ds-writing-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 20px; color: var(--muted, #505b68); font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-writing-meta span:first-child { color: var(--accent, #2549ce); } .ds-writing h2 { font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.4rem); line-height: 1.22; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.035em; margin: 16px 0; max-width: 28ch; } .ds-writing h2 a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-writing h2 a:hover { color: var(--accent, #2549ce); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-writing a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2549ce); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-writing p { color: var(--muted, #505b68); margin-top: 0; max-width: 72ch; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-writing h2 { font-size: 26px; } }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio reads like a personal engineering publication. Cool paper, ink type, open margins and fine rules give real project descriptions room to carry the identity. Cobalt identifies interactive elements. All projects use the same neutral row treatment.

The same restrained vocabulary supports Turkish and English navigation, technical articles, selected reading and application documents. Information is progressively disclosed through native details elements; the default view remains easy to scan. Decoration does not compete with project names or readable prose.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral surfaces with one cobalt accent family.
Archivo for the identity, headings, prose and interface labels.
Open columns and ruled rows with compact metadata.
Native disclosures, visible focus and concise state changes.
Text and inline SVG rather than invented imagery.

rules.name: The Cobalt Signal Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks interactive affordances; all project surfaces stay neutral.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Archivo carries identity, headings, body and interface labels; monospace is reserved for code.

rules.name: The Ruled Page Rule
rules.body: Separate content with spacing, fine rules and tonal fields; do not add floating surfaces or ornamental shadows.

dos: Do use the source palette and local Archivo asset across the shared portfolio surfaces.
Do separate long-form content with readable measures, whitespace and rules.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, native disclosure semantics and accessible state attributes.
Do carry the same information hierarchy into the single-column layout.
Do distinguish static source verification from rendered visual approval.
donts: Don't add decorative eyebrow labels, icon tiles or invented project imagery.
Don't turn the project index and reading rows into rounded, elevated cards.
Don't use monospace as decorative interface labeling.
Don't add gradients, ornamental shadows or looping animation to this visual system.
Don't treat sidecar preview ramps or unused CSS variables as production color tokens.
